name: Career Start (formerly Certificate 3 Guarantee)
summary: Queensland Government subsidy for a first post-school Certificate III; you pay a co-contribution fee to the provider.
key: Career Start provides Queensland job seekers with skills and support to start their career.
who: Aged 15 or older and no longer in school.
Australian or NZ citizen, permanent resident, or temporary resident with an eligible visa.
TAFE Queensland adds: not enrolled in another qualification and no Certificate III or higher completed in the last 10 years.
how: Enrol with an approved provider such as TAFE Queensland; compare co-contribution fees as providers set their own.
catches: Up to 2 funded training places; not two general-pathway qualifications.
The Queensland pages fetched do not state that Career Start replaced the Certificate 3 Guarantee, though TAFE Queensland no longer lists the old name.
